sections.en: Invocations
Salutations to the Guru
Salutations to Brāhmaṇas and saints
Salutations to the wicked
Contrast between saints and the evil-minded
Salutations to all living beings as so many images of Śrī Rāma

sections.hi: तुलसीदासजीकी दीनता और रामभक्तिमयी कविताकी महिमा
sections.en: Tulasīdāsa’s humility and the glory of poetry describing Śrī Rāma’s greatness
Salutations to the immortal bards

sections.hi: वाल्मीकि, वेद, ब्रह्मा, देवता, शिव, पार्वती आदिकी वन्दना
sections.en: Salutations to the sage Vālmīki, the Vedas, Brahmā, Śiva, Pārvatī and other gods and goddesses
Salutations to the abode and companions of Sītā and Rāma
Salutations to and the glory of the Name
The excellences of Śrī Rāma and the greatness of His story
The date of composition of the Rāmacaritamānasa
The metaphorical representation of the Mānasa as a lake and its glory
Dialogue between the sages— Yājñavalkya and Bharadvāja and the greatness of Prayāga

sections.hi: सतीका भ्रम, श्रीरामजीका ऐश्वर्य और सतीका खेद
sections.en: Satī’s bewilderment, Śrī Rāma’s divine glory and Satī’s remorse
Repudiation of Satī by Śiva and Śiva’s Samādhi (trance)
Satī’s visit to Dakṣa’s sacrifice

sections.hi: पतिके अपमानसे दुःखी होकर सतीका योगाग्निसे जल जाना, दक्ष-यज्ञ-विध्वंस
sections.en: Satī’s self-immolation through the fire of Yoga out of indignation at the slight offered to Her Spouse by Her father: destruction of Dakṣa’s sacrifice
Descent of Goddess Pārvatī and Her penance
Śrī Rāma’s intercession with Bhagavān Śiva for marriage
Pārvatī’s unique fidelity as revealed through Her test by the seven seers

sections.hi: कामदेवका देवकार्यके लिये जाना और भस्म होना
sections.en: Love’s departure on the errand of the gods and his being burnt to death
Śiva’s boon to Rati (Cupid’s consort)

sections.hi: देवताओंका शिवजीसे ब्याहके लिये प्रार्थना करना, सप्तर्षियोंका पार्वतीके पास जाना
sections.en: The god’s prayer to Śiva for marriage; the seven seers’ visit to Pārvatī

sections.hi: शिवजीकी विचित्र बारात और विवाहकी तैयारी
sections.en: Śiva’s peculiar marriage procession and preparations for the wedding (undertaken by the other party)
Śiva’s nuptials
A dialogue between Śiva and Pārvatī
Causes of Śrī Rāma’s Descent
Ego’s sway over Nārada and the effect of the Lord’s Māyā

sections.hi: विश्वमोहिनीका स्वयंवर, शिवगणोंको तथा भगवान्‌को शाप और नारदका मोह-भंग
sections.en: Princess Viśvamohinī’s self-selection of a husband; Nārada’s pronouncing a curse on the attendants of Śiva as well as on the Lord Himself and his subsequent release from the spell of infatuation
The austerities of Manu and Śatarūpā and their receiving boon from the Lord
The story of king Pratāpabhānu

sections.hi: रावणादिका जन्म, तपस्या और उनका ऐश्वर्य तथा अत्याचार
sections.en: The birth of Rāvaṇa and his brothers, their austerities, opulence and tyranny
The piteous appeal of mother Earth and other gods
The Lord’s compassion on them

sections.hi: राजा दशरथका पुत्रेष्टि यज्ञ, रानियोंका गर्भवती होना
sections.en: King Daśaratha’s sacrifice for the birth of a son and his Queens’ pregnancy
The Lord’s manifestation and the delightful nature of His childish sports
Viśvāmitra visits king Daśaratha and asks for Śrī Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa
Protection of Viśvāmitra’s sacrifice
Redemption of Ahalyā
Entry of Viśvāmitra with Śrī Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa into the precincts of Mithilā
Janaka’s ecstasy of love at the sight of Śrī Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa
A visit to the town by Śrī Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa

sections.hi: पुष्पवाटिका-निरीक्षण, सीताजीका प्रथम दर्शन, श्रीसीतारामजीका परस्पर दर्शन
sections.en: Śrī Rāma’s visit to Janaka’s garden; Rāma and Sītā catch sight of each other

sections.hi: श्रीसीताजीका पार्वती-पूजन एवं वरदानप्राप्ति तथा राम-लक्ष्मण-संवाद
sections.en: Worship of Goddess Pārvatī by Sītā, Her receiving blessings from the Goddess and a dialogue between Śrī Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa
Śrī Rāma’s entry into the pavilion erected for the Bow-stringing performance alongwith Lakṣmaṇa
Sītā’s entry into the pavilion
Proclamation of Janaka’s vow by his heralds

sections.hi: राजाओंसे धनुष न उठना, जनककी निराशाजनक वाणी
sections.en: The princes’ failure to lift the bow and Janaka’s despondent utterance
Lakṣmaṇa’s fulmination
The breaking of the Bow
Sītā places the wreath of victory round Śrī Rāma’s neck
Arrival of Paraśurāma, exchange of sharp words between Lakṣmaṇa and Paraśurāma and Śrī Rāma’s triumph over the latter

sections.hi: दशरथजीके पास जनकजीका दूत भेजना,अयोध्यासे बारातका प्रस्थान
sections.en: Janaka’s despatching of messengers to Ayodhyā and departure of the marriage procession from there
Arrival of the marriage procession and its reception etc., at Janakapura
The wedding of Sītā and Śrī Rāma and Their farewell

sections.hi: बारातका अयोध्या लौटना और अयोध्यामें आनन्द
sections.en: Return of the marriage procession to Ayodhyā and rejoicing in the city
The glory of hearing and singing the story of Śrī Rāma
Invocations

sections.hi: रामराज्याभिषेककी तैयारी, देवताओंकी व्याकुलता तथा सरस्वतीजीसे उनकी प्रार्थना
sections.en: Preparations for Śrī Rāma’s installation as the Prince Regent of Ayodhyā; the god’s concern over the same and their approaching Goddess Sarasvatī for help
Sarasvatī perverts the mind of Mantharā (a handmaid of queen Kaikeyī); dialogue between Kaikeyī and Mantharā
Kaikeyī enters the sulking-chamber

sections.hi: दशरथ-कैकेयी-संवाद और दशरथ-शोक, सुमन्त्रका महलमें जाना और वहाँसे लौटकर श्रीरामजीको महलमें भेजना
sections.en: Dialogue between king Daśaratha and Kaikeyī; Daśaratha’s lamentation; Sumantra goes to the palace and, returning from it, sends Śrī Rāma to His father
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma and mother Kaikeyī
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma and His father; the sadness of the people of Ayodhyā; their remonstrances with Kaikeyī
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma and mother Kausalyā
Dialogue between Sītā and Śrī Rāma
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma, Kausalyā and Sītā
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa
Dialogue between Lakṣmaṇa and mother Sumitrā

sections.hi: श्रीरामजी, लक्ष्मणजी, सीताजीका महाराज दशरथके पास विदा माँगने जाना, दशरथजीका सीताजीको समझाना
sections.en: Śrī Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Sītā call on king Daśaratha to take leave of him; Daśaratha’s exhortation to Sītā

sections.hi: श्रीराम-सीता-लक्ष्मणका वनगमन और नगर-निवासियोंको सोये छोड़कर आगे बढ़ना
sections.en: Śrī Rāma, Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa proceed to the woods and slip past the citizens, deep in sleep

sections.hi: श्रीरामका शृङ्गवेरपुर पहुँचना, निषादके द्वारा सेवा
sections.en: Śrī Rāma’s arrival at Śṛṅgaverapura; the Niṣāda chief’s services

sections.hi: लक्ष्मण-निषाद-संवाद, श्रीराम-सीतासे सुमन्त्रका संवाद, सुमन्त्रका लौटना
sections.en: Dialogue between Lakṣmaṇa and the Niṣāda; Sumantra’s dialogue with Śrī Rāma and Sītā and his departing for Ayodhyā
The boatman’s love and the passage across the Gaṅgā, Sītā’s prayer to Gaṅgā
Arrival at Prayāga and dialogue between Śrī Rāma and the sage Bharadvāja; the love of the people inhabiting the bank of the Yamunā
The episode of an ascetic
Śrī Rāma greets the Yamunā; love of the villagers
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma and the sage Vālmīki
Śrī Rāma takes up His abode at Citrakūṭa; the services of the Kolas and Bhīlas

sections.hi: सुमन्त्रका अयोध्याको लौटना और सर्वत्र शोक देखना
sections.en: Sumantra returns to Ayodhyā and finds the city a picture of grief
Dialogue between king Daśaratha and Sumantra, Daśaratha’s passing away

sections.hi: मुनि वसिष्ठका भरतजीको बुलानेके लिये दूत भेजना
sections.en: The sage Vasiṣṭha sends envoys to call Bharata
Arrival and lamentation of Bharata and Śatrughna
Dialogue between Bharata and mother Kausalyā and king Daśaratha’s cremation

sections.hi: वसिष्ठ-भरत-संवाद, श्रीरामजीको लानेके लिये चित्रकूट जानेकी तैयारी
sections.en: Dialogue between the sage Vasiṣṭha and Bharata; Bharata prepares for a journey to Citrakūṭa in order to bring Śrī Rāma back to Ayodhyā
Departure of Bharata and Śatrughna with the citizens of Ayodhyā to the woods
The Niṣāda’s suspicion and precautions

sections.hi: भरत-निषाद-मिलन और संवाद एवं भरतजीका तथा नगरवासियोंका प्रेम
sections.en: Bharata’s meeting and dialogue with the Niṣāda chief; the love of Bharata and the citizens of Ayodhyā for Śrī Rāma
Bharata’s arrival at Prayāga and dialogue between Bharata and the sage Bharadvāja
Bharadvāja shows hospitality to Bharata
Dialogue between Indra and his preceptor (the sage Bṛhaspati)
Bharata on his way to Citrakūṭa

sections.hi: श्रीसीताजीका स्वप्न, श्रीरामजीको कोल-किरातोंद्वारा भरतजीके आगमनकी सूचना, रामजीका शोक, लक्ष्मणजीका क्रोध
sections.en: Sītā’s dream; the Kolas and Kirātas bring news of Bharata’s arrival to Śrī Rāma; Śrī Rāma’s concern at the report; Lakṣmaṇa’s outburst of passion

sections.hi: श्रीरामजीका लक्ष्मणजीको समझाना एवं भरतजीकी महिमा कहना
sections.en: Śrī Rāma admonishes Lakṣmaṇa and dwells on Bharata’s greatness

sections.hi: भरतजीका मन्दाकिनी-स्नान, चित्रकूटमें पहुँचना, भरतादि सबका परस्पर मिलाप, पिताका शोक और श्राद्ध
sections.en: Bharata takes a dip in the Mandākinī and arrives at Citrakūṭa; Bharata and others meet one another, mourn the king’s death and perform his Śrāddha (obsequies)

sections.hi: वनवासियोंद्वारा भरतजीकी मण्डलीका सत्कार, कैकेयीका पश्चात्ताप
sections.en: Hospitality of the foresters towards Bharata and his party; Kaikeyī’s remorse
Vasiṣṭha’s speech
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma, Bharata and others

sections.hi: जनकजीका पहुँचना, कोल-किरातादिकी भेंट, सबका परस्पर मिलाप
sections.en: King Janaka’s arrival at Citrakūṭa; the Kolas and Kirātas offer presents to the visitors and all meet one another
Dialogue between queens Kausalyā and Sunayanā (king Janaka’s wife); Sītā’s amiability
Dialogue between king Janaka and his wife; Bharata’s glory
Dialogue between king Janaka and Bharata; Indra’s anxiety; Goddess Sarasvatī’s admonition to Indra
Dialogue between the sage Vasiṣṭha, Śrī Rāma and Bharata
Bharata deposits the sacred waters; his perambulation through Citrakūṭa
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma and Bharata; Śrī Rāma’s gift of His sandals; Bharata’s farewell

sections.hi: भरतजीका अयोध्या लौटना, भरतजीद्वारा पादुकाकी स्थापना, नन्दिग्राममें निवास और श्रीभरतजीके चरित्र-श्रवणकी महिमा
sections.en: Returning to Ayodhyā, Bharata places the Lord’s sandals on the throne and takes up his residence at Nandigrāma; the virtue of listening to Bharata’s story
Invocations
Jayanta’s mischief and punishment
Meeting with sage Atri and his hymn of praise to Śrī Rāma

sections.hi: श्रीसीता-अनसूया-मिलन और श्रीसीताजीको अनसूयाजीका पातिव्रतधर्म कहना
sections.en: Sītā’s meeting with Anasūyā (Atri’s wife) and the latter’s discourse on the duties of a devoted wife

sections.hi: श्रीरामजीका आगे प्रस्थान, विराध-वध और शरभङ्ग-प्रसङ्ग
sections.en: Śrī Rāma proceeds further and kills Virādha; the episode of the sage Śarabhaṅga
Śrī Rāma takes a vow to kill the demons

sections.hi: सुतीक्ष्णजीका प्रेम, अगस्त्य-मिलन, अगस्त्य संवाद, रामका दण्डक-वन-प्रवेश और जटायु-मिलन
sections.en: Sutīkṣṇa’s love and Śrī Rāma’s meeting with the sage Agastya; dialogue with Agastya; Śrī Rāma’s entry into the Daṇḍaka forest and His meeting with Jaṭāyu
Śrī Rāma takes up His abode at Pañcavaṭī; dialogue between Śrī Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa

sections.hi: शूर्पणखाकी कथा, शूर्पणखाका खर-दूषणके पास जाना और खर-दूषणादिका वध
sections.en: The story of Śūrpaṇakhā; her approaching Khara, Dūṣaṇa and Triśirā for redress and their subsequent death at Śrī Rāma’s hands

sections.hi: शूर्पणखाका रावणके निकट जाना, श्रीसीताजीका अग्नि-प्रवेश और माया-सीता
sections.en: Śūrpaṇakhā approaches Rāvaṇa; Sītā enters into the fire leaving Her shadow behind

sections.hi: मारीचप्रसंग और स्वर्णमृगरूपमें मारीचका मारा जाना
sections.en: The episode of Mārīca and how he was killed in the form of a gold deer
Sītā’s abduction and Her wailing
The combat of Jaṭāyu with Rāvaṇa
Śrī Rāma’s lament; His meeting with Jaṭāyu
Deliverance of Kabandha

sections.hi: शबरीपर कृपा, नवधा भक्ति-उपदेश और पम्पासरकी ओर प्रस्थान
sections.en: Grace on Śabarī; description of the nine forms of Devotion and departure for the Pampā lake
Dialogue between the sage Nārada and Śrī Rāma

sections.hi: संतोंके लक्षण और सत्संग-भजनके लिये प्रेरणा
sections.en: The glory of hearing the praises of Śrī Rāma and an exhortation to cultivate fellowship with saints and practise adoration
Invocations

sections.hi: श्रीरामजीसे हनुमान्‌जीका मिलना और श्रीराम-सुग्रीवकी मित्रता
sections.en: Śrī Rāma’s meeting with Hanumān and the conclusion of an alliance between Śrī Rāma and Sugrīva

sections.hi: सुग्रीवका दुःख सुनाना, बालिवधकी प्रतिज्ञा, श्रीरामजीका मित्र-लक्षण-वर्णन
sections.en: Sugrīva apprizes Śrī Rāma of his woes; the latter’s vow to kill Vāli; Śrī Rāma expatiates on the characteristics of a friend
Sugrīva’s dispassion
Duel between Vāli and Sugrīva; deliverance of Vāli

sections.hi: ताराका विलाप, ताराको श्रीरामजीद्वारा उपदेश और सुग्रीवका राज्याभिषेक तथा अंगदको युवराजपद
sections.en: Tārā’s wail; Śrī Rāma’s advice to Tārā and Sugrīva’s coronation and Aṅgada’s installation as his Heir- Apparent
A description of the rainy season
Śrī Rāma’s show of displeasure towards Sugrīva and Lakṣmaṇa’s wrath

sections.hi: सुग्रीव-राम-संवाद और सीताजीकी खोजके लिये बंदरोंका प्रस्थान
sections.en: Dialogue between Sugrīva and Śrī Rāma and the departure of the monkeys in quest of Sītā
Their meeting with a hermitess in a cavern

sections.hi: वानरोंका समुद्रतटपर आना, सम्पातीसे भेंट और बातचीत
sections.en: The monkeys’ arrival at the seashore; their meeting and conversation with Sampātī (Jaṭāyu’s brother)

sections.hi: समुद्र लाँघनेका परामर्श, जाम्बवन्तका हनुमान्‌जीको बल याद दिलाकर उत्साहित करना
sections.en: Sampātī’s advice to the monkeys to leap across the ocean; Jāmbavān encourages Hanumān by reminding him of his strength
The greatness of Śrī Rāma’s glories
Invocations

sections.hi: हनुमान्‌जीका लङ्काको प्रस्थान, सुरसासे भेंट,छाया पकड़नेवाली राक्षसीका वध
sections.en: Hanumān leaves for Laṅkā, meets Surasā and kills the image-catching demoness
Description of Laṅkā; Hanumān strikes Laṅkinī and enters Laṅkā
Hanumān meets Vibhīṣaṇa

sections.hi: हनुमान्‌जीका अशोकवाटिकामें सीताको देखकर दुःखी होना और रावणका सीताजीको भय दिखलाना
sections.en: Hanumān’s grief at the sight of Sītā in the Aśoka grove and Rāvaṇa’s threat to Sītā
Dialogue between Sītā and Trijaṭā
Dialogue between Sītā and Hanumān

sections.hi: हनुमान्‌जीद्वारा अशोकवाटिका-विध्वंस, अक्षयकुमार-वध और मेघनादका हनुमान्‌जीको नागपाशमें बाँधकर सभामें ले जाना
sections.en: Hanumān lays waste the Aśoka grove and kills prince Akṣaya; at last Meghanāda entangles Hanumān in a noose of Brahmā and carries him off to Rāvaṇa’s court
Dialogue between Hanumān and Rāvaṇa
Burning of Laṅkā

sections.hi: लङ्का जलानेके बाद हनुमान्‌जीका सीताजीसे विदा माँगना और चूड़ामणि पाना
sections.en: After burning Laṅkā Hanumān asks leave of Sītā and obtains the crest-jewel from Her

sections.hi: समुद्रके इस पार आना, सबका लौटना, मधुवन-प्रवेश,सुग्रीव-मिलन, श्रीराम-हनुमान्-संवाद
sections.en: On Hanumān’s reaching the opposite shore all the monkeys return and enter Madhuvana; their meeting with Sugrīva and the dialogue between Śrī Rāma and Hanumān

sections.hi: श्रीरामजीका वानरोंकी सेनाके साथ चलकर समुद्रतटपर पहुँचना
sections.en: Śrī Rāma’s march to the beach alongwith the army of monkeys
Dialogue between Mandodarī and Rāvaṇa

sections.hi: रावणको विभीषणका समझाना और विभीषणका अपमान
sections.en: Vibhīṣaṇa offers advice to Rāvaṇa and meets with an affront at the latter’s hands

sections.hi: विभीषणका भगवान् श्रीरामजीकी शरणके लिये प्रस्थान और शरणप्राप्ति
sections.en: Vibhīṣaṇa sallies forth to obtain Śrī Rāma’s protection and secures it

sections.hi: समुद्र पार करनेके लिये विचार, रावणदूत शुकका आना और लक्ष्मणजीके पत्रको लेकर लौटना
sections.en: Deliberation over the question of crossing the sea; appearance of Śuka, a spy of Rāvaṇa, and his return with Lakṣmaṇa’s letter

sections.hi: दूतका रावणको समझाना और लक्ष्मणजीका पत्र देना
sections.en: The spy gives counsel to Rāvaṇa and delivers Lakṣmaṇa’s note to him

sections.hi: समुद्रपर श्रीरामजीका क्रोध और समुद्रकी विनती
sections.en: Śrī Rāma’s fury against the sea and the latter’s supplication
Glory of hymning Śrī Rāma’s glories
Invocations

sections.hi: नल-नीलद्वारा पुल बाँधना, श्रीरामजीद्वारा श्रीरामेश्वरकी स्थापना
sections.en: Bridging of the ocean by Nala and Nīla; Śrī Rāma’s installation of Śrī Rāmeśvara Liṅgam

sections.hi: श्रीरामजीका सेनासहित समुद्र पार उतरना, सुबेल पर्वतपर निवास, रावणकी व्याकुलता
sections.en: Śrī Rāma crosses the ocean with the whole army and encamps on Mount Suvela; Rāvaṇa feels agitated at the news
Mandodarī expostulates with Rāvaṇa; dialogue between Rāvaṇa and Prahasta (his son)
A description of Śrī Rāma on Mount Suvela and a view of the rising moon
An arrow from Śrī Rāma’s bow strikes down Rāvaṇa’s diadems and umbrella

sections.hi: मन्दोदरीका फिर रावणको समझाना और श्रीरामकी महिमा कहना
sections.en: Mandodarī makes remonstrance with Rāvaṇa again and dwells upon Śrī Rāma’s glory

sections.hi: अंगदजीका लंका जाना और रावणकी सभामें अंगद-रावण-संवाद
sections.en: Aṅgada’s departure for Laṅkā and dialogue between Aṅgada and Rāvaṇa in the latter’s court
Mandodarī offers advice to Rāvaṇa once more
Dialogue between Aṅgada and Śrī Rāma; war actually begins
Mālyavān’s admonition to Rāvaṇa
The battle recommences; encounter between Lakṣmaṇa and Meghanāda; a javelin thrown by the latter strikes Lakṣmaṇa in the breast

sections.hi: हनुमान्‌जीका सुषेण वैद्यको लाना एवं संजीवनीके लिये जाना, कालनेमि-रावण-संवाद, मकरी-उद्धार, कालनेमि-उद्धार
sections.en: Hanumān fetches the physician Suṣeṇa and proceeds in quest of the life-giving herb; dialogue between Kālanemi and Rāvaṇa, redemption of the she-alligator; deliverance of Kālanemi

sections.hi: भरतजीके बाणसे हनुमान्‌का मूर्च्छित होना, भरत-हनुमान्-संवाद
sections.en: Struck by Bharata’s arrow, Hanumān drops down unconscious; dialogue between Bharata and Hanumān

sections.hi: श्रीरामजीकी प्रलापलीला, हनुमान्‌जीका लौटना, लक्ष्मणजीका उठ बैठना
sections.en: Śrī Rāma’s sport of a touching wail; Hanumān’s return; Lakṣmaṇa’s coming back to consciousness

sections.hi: रावणका कुम्भकर्णको जगाना, कुम्भकर्णका रावणको उपदेश और विभीषण-कुम्भकर्ण-संवाद
sections.en: Rāvaṇa awakes Kumbhakarṇa; Kumbhakarṇa’s exhortation to Rāvaṇa and dialogue between Vibhīṣaṇa and Kumbhakarṇa
Kumbhakarṇa joins the battle and attains final beatitude

sections.hi: मेघनादका युद्ध, रामजीका लीलासे नागपाशमें बँधना
sections.en: Meghanāda gives battle and Śrī Rāma sportfully allows Himself to be bound by a snare of serpents
Destruction of Meghanāda’s sacrificial performance; his engagement on the battle-field and deliverance at the hands of Lakṣmaṇa

sections.hi: रावणका युद्धके लिये प्रस्थान और श्रीरामजीका विजय-रथ तथा वानर-राक्षसोंका युद्ध
sections.en: Rāvaṇa’s march to the field of battle; Śrī Rāma’s victory-chariot and an encounter between the monkey- warriors and the demons
Encounter between Lakṣmaṇa and Rāvaṇa
Rāvaṇa’s swoon; destruction of his sacrificial performance; combat between Śrī Rāma and Rāvaṇa

sections.hi: इन्द्रका श्रीरामजीके लिये रथ भेजना, राम-रावण-युद्ध
sections.en: Indra (the lord of paradise) sends a chariot for the use of Śrī Rāma; encounter between Śrī Rāma and Rāvaṇa

sections.hi: रावणका विभीषणपर शक्ति छोड़ना, रामजीका शक्तिको अपने ऊपर लेना, विभीषण-रावण-युद्ध
sections.en: Rāvaṇa hurls a lance at Vibhīṣaṇa : Śrī Rāma puts Vibhīṣaṇa behind Him and exposes Himself to its full force; encounter between Vibhīṣaṇa and Rāvaṇa

sections.hi: रावण-हनुमान्-युद्ध, रावणका माया रचना, रामजीद्वारा माया-नाश
sections.en: Combat of Rāvaṇa and Hanumān; Rāvaṇa creates phantoms and Śrī Rāma disperses the phantoms
Fierce fighting; Rāvaṇa’s swoon
Dialogue between Sītā and Trijaṭā
Final encounter between Śrī Rāma and Rāvaṇa; end of Rāvaṇa; shouts of victory everywhere
Mandodarī and other queens lament; Rāvaṇa’s funeral
Vibhīṣaṇa’s installation

sections.hi: हनुमान्‌जीका सीताजीको कुशल सुनाना, सीताजीका आगमन और अग्नि-परीक्षा
sections.en: Hanumān carries the happy news to Sītā; Sītā rejoins Śrī Rāma and enters fire as a test of her purity and restoration real Sītā by the God of Fire to Lord Śrī Rāma
The gods sing the Lord’s glories; Indra rains down nectar on the dead

sections.hi: विभीषणकी प्रार्थना, श्रीरामजीके द्वारा भरतजीके प्रेमदशाका वर्णन,शीघ्र अयोध्या पहुँचनेका अनुरोध
sections.en: Vibhīṣaṇa’s entreaty; Śrī Rāma’s portrayal of Bharata’s condition due to the excessive love he bore towards the Lord; Śrī Rāma urges Vibhīṣaṇa to arrange for His speedy return to Ayodhyā

sections.hi: विभीषणका वस्त्राभूषण बरसाना और वानर-भालुओंका उन्हें पहनना
sections.en: Vibhīṣaṇa rains down raiments and jewels from the air and the monkeys and bears pick them up and adorn their person with them

sections.hi: पुष्पकविमानपर चढ़कर श्रीसीता-रामजीका अवधके लिये प्रस्थान
sections.en: Śrī Rāma and Sītā leave for Ayodhyā by the aerial car, Puṣpaka
The glory of Śrī Rāma’s story
Invocations
Bharata’s desolation; meeting of Bharata and Hanumān; rejoicing in Ayodhyā
Śrī Rāma’s Reception; meeting with Bharata; universal rejoicing on meeting Śrī Rāma
Śrī Rāma’s Coronation; Vedas’ alleluia; Lord Śiva’s alleluia
Śrī Rāma bestows parting presents on the monkeys and the Niṣāda chief
Account of Śrī Rāma’s Reign

sections.hi: पुत्रोत्पत्ति, अयोध्याजीकी रमणीयता,सनकादिका आगमन और संवाद
sections.en: Birth of sons to the four brothers; Ayodhyā’s loveliness; arrival of the sage Sanaka and his three brothers and their dialogue with Śrī Rāma

sections.hi: हनुमान्‌जीके द्वारा भरतजीका प्रश्न और श्रीरामजीका उपदेश
sections.en: Hanumān’s introduction of Bharata’s question and Śrī Rāma’s discourse on the subject
Śrī Rāma’s exhortation to His subjects (Śrī Rāma-Gītā); the citizens’ acknowledgement
Dialogue between Śrī Rāma and the sage Vasiṣṭha; Śrī Rāma’s excursion to a mango grove in the company of His brothers

sections.hi: नारदजीका आना और स्तुति करके ब्रह्मलोकको लौट जाना
sections.en: Nārada’s visit and return to Brahmā’s abode after hymning the Lord’s praises

sections.hi: शिव-पार्वती-संवाद, गरुड़-मोह, गरुड़जीका काकभुशुण्डिसे रामकथा और राम-महिमा सुनना
sections.en: Dialogue between Lord Śiva and Goddess Pārvatī; Garuḍa’s delusion; Garuḍa listens to Śrī Rāma’s story and to an account of His glory from Kākabhuśuṇḍi

sections.hi: काकभुशुण्डिका अपनी पूर्वजन्मकथा और कलिमहिमा कहना
sections.en: Kākabhuśuṇḍi narrates the story of his previous lives and tells Garuḍa the glory of the Kali age

sections.hi: गुरुजीका अपमान एवं शिवजीके शापकी बात सुनना
sections.en: Insult offered by him to his preceptor in a previous birth and the curse pronounced on him by Lord Śiva
A hymn of eight verses addressed to Lord Śiva

sections.hi: गुरुजीका शिवजीसे अपराध-क्षमापन, शापानुग्रह और काकभुशुण्डिकी आगेकी कथा
sections.en: Guru’s appeal to Lord Śiva for forgiving the wrong; mollification of the curse; continuation of Kākabhuśuṇḍi’s narrative

sections.hi: काकभुशुण्डिजीका लोमशजीके पास जाना और शाप तथा अनुग्रह पाना
sections.en: Kākabhuśuṇḍi approaches the sage Lomaśa, who first pronounces a curse on him but later on showers his grace and bestows a boon on him

sections.hi: ज्ञान-भक्ति-निरूपण, ज्ञानदीपक और भक्तिकी महान्‌ महिमा
sections.en: Delineation of Jñāna and Devotion; a description of the Lamp of wisdom and the surpassing glory of Devotion

sections.hi: गरुड़जीके सात प्रश्न तथा काकभुशुण्डिके उत्तर
sections.en: Seven questions of Garuḍa and Kākabhuśuṇḍi’s replies to them
Glory of adoration
Greatness of the Rāmāyaṇa; Tulasīdāsa’s prayer and reward of reciting this poem
